architecture.mechanism: Reinforcement learning-based adaptive wire gauge selection enforcing voltage-drop limits and temperature-aware ampacity
architecture.intervention: Replace the fixed-gauge wiring in the centroid-to-battery segment of the 2021 Chevrolet Malibu harness with conductors sized by an RL-derived policy that maintains voltage drop below 0.36 V across dynamic driving temperatures up to 105°C.
architecture.expected_effect: Permanent restoration of module communication and vehicle operation by eliminating intermittent contact failures caused by thermal expansion and excessive voltage drop under high-load scenarios.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle under a 12-zone high-application load profile at 85°C ambient temperature; if the measured voltage drop exceeds 0.36 V or communication faults recur, the mechanism has failed.
